input.summary:
P3 kitchen design is in parts/room-25.mjs: barrel counter with a potted poppy on the west wall, lit smoker and furnace on the east window wall, and a hanging lantern at (58,4,19). Doorway cells and the one lane stay clear.
In scratch, outside runParts, `mcd room` says OK: walk 5/5 cells, light min 12, FIT OK.
The real build cannot place it: runParts refuses all 5 writes, because shell-west fills every interior cell with air and the lock owns air. build.nbt is whole but this room is empty.

waste.what: Found the air-lock refusal only after the first make.sh, then hand-built a scratch copy (load build.nbt, call build(g) without runParts) to test the design
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls and a scratch script in /tmp/part32-scratch
waste.tool: runParts option (or a per-part flag like carve) letting room parts write into air that the shell filled, or a `mcd room --scratch` that runs one part outside the lock and reports the verdict

waste.what: Worked out the 3x2 floor cell by cell (doorway first cells, the single lane, which cells can take furniture) by hand from mcd plan
waste.cost: about 5 minutes of reasoning on 6 cells
waste.tool: mcd plan could print a candidate layout check (walk and light verdict per furniture draft) before any build

companions.task: Decide how interior air owned by the shell is handed to room parts (let rooms write into shell-filled air, or leave interiors unset in shell-west and shell-east) so all room parts can place furniture.
Check the light plan for the 3x2 kitchen once it is built in the real pipeline; the scratch run gave min 12, so the lantern may be optional.

left: Blocked: runParts refuses all 5 kitchen writes because shell-west fills the interior with air (`g.fill(..., "air")`) and the lock treats that air as owned. The fix is in the kit (runParts or shell-west), not this module. Recorded in plan.md Notes.
Not verified: whether the other room parts hit the same lock. I checked only P3 kitchen.

No table: the 3x2 kitchen has no room for one without blocking the only lane (59,20) between the front door and the back door. Spec asks for a kitchen with a table; the dining room next door has to carry it.
The stove front faces west into the room and the scratch render was not checked for the stove itself; only the barrel and lantern showed in the view.
Structure check reports floating stairs in P4/P5/P7 and an unsupported ladder at 11,6,17. Those are other parts' cells, not this one's.
